correctness.rationale: Full-spark 4×8 coefficient matrix means any projective solution has at least five nonzero coordinates; all relevant Jacobian column subsets are independent. The sign involution has no fixed negative-eigenspace points; positive fixed locus C is the smooth (2,2,2,2) complete-intersection curve in P^5 with degree 16, K_C=O_C(2), genus 17, and normal O_C(1)^⊕2 in Y. On the normal slice the involution is -I, giving transverse A1 quotient singularities and the blowup crepant. For Yhat=Bl_CY with Ehat=P(N), H^3=16,H²Ehat=0,HEhat²=-16,Ehat³=-32; the degree-two quotient q with q*D=H and q*E=2Ehat yields (D³,D²E,DE²,E³)=(8,0,-32,-128). Independent symbolic expansion of (1+H)^8/(1+2H)^4 yields c3=-8H³ and e(Y)=-128. Since e(C)=-32, e(Yhat)=-160 and the fixed exceptional divisor has e=-64, e(Z)=(-160-64)/2=-112. Invariant cohomology and one exceptional divisor give h11=2, hence h21=58. c2.E=e(E)-E³=64; six invariant hyperplane sections, nef-big vanishing and Riemann–Roch give c2.D=56. Smooth blowup is simply connected by Lefschetz and codimension-two blowup, and Armstrong's fixed-point-quotient theorem kills the involution group in π1(Z). The argument supports all full-spark coefficient matrices, not only sample Vandermonde matrices. Independent exact symbolic arithmetic checked all displayed numerical identities; finite t=3..8 verifier code was inspected, not substituted for proofs. The line-bundle descent uses trivial stabilizer action on the positive fixed stratum; rational Picard spanning, not an integral basis, is asserted.
